item.text: {"action":"experiment","hypothesis":"A05’s gain over the global G01 model may be driven mainly by the cu_o-specific extra_trees/raw fit, while its separate other-route fit may be unnecessary or mildly harmful. Any subgroup benefit without both conditions is only a tradeoff, not an eligible win.","reason":"The continuation minimum is pending, and this valid untried specification follows the previous reflection’s focused A05 ablation.
